program.section_heading: Nursing Assistant  - Noncredit Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Demonstrate the skills and knowledge needed to pass the California state nursing assistant certification examination.
Perform basic nursing and personal care skills for residents from diverse and multicultural backgrounds.
Use critical thinking as a basis for effective decision making.
List and discuss various career opportunities available to them through professional development.
Communicate effectively and with residents, families and members of the health care team.

notes: Noncredit program counted in hours; course figures are hour ranges as printed (e.g., 56.00 - 63.00), and the total is printed as 'Hours: 188.00- 211.50' and 'Total : 188.00- 211.50'.
The requirements list has no explicit 'all required' heading; read as all courses required since they are listed under Program Requirements with a total equal to their sum.
The outcome 'Communicate effectively and with residents, families and members of the health care team.' is copied as printed, including the apparent stray 'and'.

Certified Nurse Assistant (CNA), Home Health Aide (HHA) and Acute Care Technician (ACT) are named as certifications/examinations rather than explicitly as careers; not recorded as careers. Reviewer may wish to check.
Enrollment prerequisites (background screening, health exam, CPR certification, age 16) are not course requirements and are not recorded in blocks.
